In Mode B, the sum of the left edges of the pieces (b+g) is invariant, so a mirror match (b+g=48, currently 60) is impossible here. In Mode A (before SPACE), only gray moves ±6, so the mirror match is achievable: SPACE → LEFT → LEFT makes gray's column 6-20, and its mirror = 42-56 = exactly the black's position (same row). Testing this 3-action sequence.
